description: Pure-noise binary twin: all betas 0, constant true probability.
sizingNote: 6,000 rows (Ruling Q9: >= 5,000). With no signal, the AUC of any model on a 20% holdout has SE about 0.017 (Hanley-McNeil at AUC 0.5), so an honest pipeline's holdout AUC stays near 0.5 and 'no model' is the clearly correct outcome.
